Good news on the account side — I just re-checked and your line 555-123-2002 is confirmed **Active** with no suspension, roaming enabled, and 8.7 GB of 15 GB used. So the account is healthy; this now looks like a device/settings issue.

From what you described, Airplane Mode appears to be off (no ✈️ icon showing), but your phone's mobile data switch is turned off. Let's work through this step by step:

**Step 1 — Turn mobile data back on**
Go to **Settings → Connections (or Network & Internet) → Mobile Networks**, and make sure **Mobile Data** is switched **ON**. This is separate from your line being active — a suspension or reboot can sometimes leave it toggled off.

**Step 2 — Check the SIM card**
In **Settings → About Phone → Status → SIM Status** (or **Settings → Connections → SIM Manager**), see whether your SIM shows as Active, Missing, or Locked.
- If it says **Missing**, power the phone off, remove the SIM tray, reseat the card firmly, and power back on.
- If it says **Locked** (PIN/PUK), don't keep trying codes — tell me and I'll escalate you to technical support for SIM security help.

**Step 3 — Check APN settings**
Go to **Settings → Connections → Mobile Networks → Access Point Names**. If the APN looks incorrect or blank, use the menu option to **Reset to Default**, then **restart your phone** — the reset won't take effect until you reboot.

**Step 4 — Check network mode preference**
In **Settings → Connections → Mobile Networks → Network Mode**, make sure it isn't set to 2G only. Choose the **5G/4G (LTE) preferred** option if available.

Try Step 1 first and see if the signal bars come back, then work through the rest. Let me know exactly what you see at each step — especially the SIM status and APN screen — and I'll take it from there.

If none of these bring your signal back, I'll transfer you to a human technical-support agent who can run advanced diagnostics on the line and device.
